evidence: eval_script.py docstring specifies invocation as: python3 eval_script.py.

eval_script.py iterates 20 test windows from test_windows.json, invokes /home/workspace/curve_positioning.py --backtest per window, aggregates per-lane scores, applies cross-window stability penalty and regime-shift bonus, emits TOTAL_SCORE <N> on stdout.
score.py implements 8 per-window scoring lanes with lane anchors capped at institutional-frontier values per PKW-FAMILIES section 3 Framework B.
positioning_results.json is generated by the submitted curve_positioning.py at judge time, so it is not listed as a required submission file.
true_regime_events.json is a hidden scoring label file used for regime-shift bonus verification and is listed only as a judge-only scoring file.
warnings: The expert scorer has no CLI arguments. All judge-only scoring data (test_windows.json, true_regime_events.json, treasury_curve_test.csv, macro_indicators_test.csv) is read directly from /home/workspace/scoring/ by eval_script.py. Per-window slices of the market-data CSVs are written into /home/workspace/ immediately before each agent invocation so that the agent script can only see data up to and including its window-end date.
The scoring directory contains curve_positioning_reference.py used ONLY under Oracle placement; the manifest treats /home/workspace/curve_positioning.py as the worker submission.
Validation failures inside eval_script.py that fail before emitting TOTAL_SCORE will produce parse_failure and zero out per the failure_policy.
